definitions.explanation: A restaurant that serves soba (buckwheat noodles), usually with udon and rice bowls as well.

examples.japanese: {蕎麦屋|そばや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{昼|ひる}ご{飯|はん}→昼ご飯：02950_hirugohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I had lunch at a soba restaurant.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{蕎麦屋|そばや}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{安|やす}くて→安い：00464_yasui⟧おいしい。
examples.english: The soba shop in front of the station is cheap and good.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大晦日|おおみそか}→大晦日：05810_oomisoka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{年越|としこ}し→年越し：12477_toshikoshi⟧そば⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{蕎麦屋|そばや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行列|ぎょうれつ}→行列：09699_gyouretsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: On New Year's Eve, lines form at soba shops as people buy their year-end soba.

notes:
Often written そば⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧.
